description: Wikimedia Commons license template names (Template namespace) that start with a prefix, e.g. Cc-zero or Cc-by-sa: template title, page ID and link. Names only, not the license texts or usage rules. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.
